caveats: Machine comparison, not independent theological or editorial approval.
Normalization deliberately ignores punctuation and may count inappropriate clipped quotations as matches.
Legacy editorial ellipses are never certified as verbatim Scripture.
The inherited Latin/Vulgate numbering for Psalms is not mapped to this Challoner witness.
French Crampon 1923 textual collation is not part of this English-only pass.
No inherited 200-bead quotes are republished by this audit.
